# DatetimePicker { #anylumino.DatetimePicker }

```python
DatetimePicker(
    value=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    min=None,
    max=None,
    step=None,
    continuous_update=True,
    width='',
)
```

Browser-native datetime picker control.

##     Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-----parameters}

value : optional
    Initial value and synced Python value.
description : optional
    Label shown above the control.
disabled : optional
    Whether user interaction is disabled.
min : optional
    Minimum date, time, or datetime value.
max : optional
    Maximum date, time, or datetime value.
step : optional
    Native input step value.
continuous_update : optional
    Whether Python receives updates while the user edits the input.
width : optional
    CSS width for the control.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.DatetimePicker.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
